dedupe_keys.name: simulation of aircraft flights with turbulence and icing conditions

description: Simulation of aircraft flights with turbulence and icing conditions is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Charles Dampeyrou et al. Turbulence and icing are dangerous situations frequently encountered in flight. It is useful to detect them to enable pilots to adapt flight, to estimate aircraft structural fatigue or to design robust flight control laws. Unfortunately, there is a lack of available data covering such phenomena. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: CSV, Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
